lines.text: On the twentieth day of the second month, the cloud lifted and Israel set out from Sinai until it settled in Paran.
Judah set out first under its standard, and the camp of Dan marched last as the rear guard.
Moses asked Hobab, son of Reuel the Midianite, to come along, but Hobab said he would go back to his own land.
Israel set out from the mountain of the LORD on a three-day journey, with the golden lampstand traveling ahead of them.
When the ark set out, Moses asked the LORD to send water to the camp, and when it rested he asked Him to return.
